SD34-001.name: Crystaneedle
SD34-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

SD34-005.name: Darkness Wyvern
SD34-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, instead, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.

[When Braved] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless.

SD34-014.name: Death Shoot
SD34-014.effect:
[Flash]
Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is used to pay the cost, instead, destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less exhausted Spirit/Ultimate.

SD34-X01.name: Dragon Demon-God
SD34-X01.effect:
This Brave doesn't exhaust, and while in Spirit condition, can't attack or block.

[When Braved on Right] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing exhausted Spirit, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[When Braved on Left] (When Attacks)
By exhausting an opposing Spirit, draw a card.

SD34-007.name: Flying Snake
SD34-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.

SD34-012.name: Necro Reverse
SD34-012.effect:
[Flash]
Summon a Cost 3 or less Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. At the end of battle, destroy the Spirit summoned by this effect. This effect can only be used during (Opposing Attack Step).

SD34-013.name: Nightmare Drain
SD34-013.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by the opponent]
Send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Trash. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Send one core each from every opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.

SD34-002.name: Shaznake
SD34-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

SD34-011.name: The Amethyst Ancient Palace
SD34-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Death Dragon" family Spirit card, or an "Imagine" family Brave card to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[LV2]
All your Spirits that activated a "When depleted/destroyed by the Opponent" effect return to your Hand rather than the Trash.

SD34-008.name: The CrystalDragon Amethyst-Dragon
SD34-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. When a Brave is summoned via this effect, draw two cards.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When any opposing Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the [When Braved] effect of the Brave braving to this Spirit, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

SD34-010.name: The DeathDragonGreatEmperor Bascarl
SD34-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
The opponent sends four cores from their Spirits/Ultimates to their Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Unless the opponent sends two cores from one of their Spirits to their Trash, they can't block.

SD34-009.name: The EvilDragon Deslar
SD34-009.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3]
This Spirit gains +7000 BP.

SD34-003.name: The SnakeMonk Harim
SD34-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

SD34-004.name: The SnakeBrawler Jagi
SD34-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
Send three cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.

[LV2][LV3]
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Spirit, all your "Dark Snake"/"Death Dragon" family Spirits gain +4000 BP.
